notes.title: Alpha 3.2
notes.content:
---

Improvements and restructuring in Mission 2

Map terrain has been improved and now looks more natural, although it still has some bugs and feels quite empty.

The money you earn in the first mission is now saved correctly.

Mission 2 is now fully playable from start to finish, though some elements still need polishing.
